# VanillaDatabase (VanillaDB)

> Enterprise-Grade Multi-Tenant SQLite Cloud Engine with High-Performance REST & SQL APIs, Live Server-Sent Events (SSE), Database-Scoped Media Streaming (HTTP 206), AES-256-GCM Encryption at Rest, Automated Backups, and Native Vector Mathematics.

- Docs Hub: https://github.com/Elaina2026/VanillaDB/blob/main/docs/README.md
- Full English Wiki: https://github.com/Elaina2026/VanillaDB/blob/main/docs/en/Home.md
- Full Vietnamese Wiki: https://github.com/Elaina2026/VanillaDB/blob/main/docs/vi/Home.md
- LLM Architecture Context: https://github.com/Elaina2026/VanillaDB/blob/main/llms.md
- Agent Guidelines: https://github.com/Elaina2026/VanillaDB/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Core Technical Specs
- Runtime: Node.js 22+ with native better-sqlite3 (WAL Mode)
- Web Framework: Fastify 5.2 (REST and SSE)
- Security: Argon2id password hashing, HMAC SHA-256 session cookies with token versioning (VDB-SEC-01), RFC 6238 TOTP with monotonic step replay protection (VDB-SEC-02), SSRF LAN blocking, AES-256-GCM media encryption
- Frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Monaco SQL Editor, Lucide Icons, Full Bilingual (EN/VI)
- Testing: Vitest end-to-end test suite (94 passed tests)
